title: Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role - We are looking for a skilled Mobile Engineer to design, develop, and maintain responsive and user-friendly mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building hybrid mobile applications, integrating REST APIs and backend services, and collaborating across the full application development lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities - Design, develop, and maintain scalable and user-friendly mobile applications. Convert UI/UX designs and business requirements into high-quality, functional mobile interfaces. Develop reusable and maintainable mobile components. Build and maintain mobile application logic and integrations with backend services. Integrate mobile applications with REST APIs and backend services. Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases and understand application data requirements. Ensure applications are responsive, secure, performant, and compatible across supported mobile platforms and devices. Troubleshoot and resolve mobile, backend, and integration issues. Optimize application performance and scalability. Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other developers. Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards and best practices. Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and continuous improvement. 
 Technical Skills - Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Hands-on experience with React Native and Ionic Framework. Experience building hybrid mobile applications and functional, effective platforms. Experience integrating RESTful APIs and backend services. Experience with backend technologies such as Java and Spring Boot. Good understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL. Experience with Git and version control. Strong understanding of responsive design and cross-device compatibility. Understanding of mobile/web security, performance optimization, and scalable application development. Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and deployment. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with knowledge of automated testing and mobile/backend testing frameworks. Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. 
 What Were Looking For - Strong ownership and accountability for delivering quality mobile solutions. Attention to detail and focus on creating excellent user experiences. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute across mobile and backend development.
